scope: The Charles Dickens passenger terminal building at the Eurotunnel terminal in Coquelles as photographed in July 2024, including the outgoing passenger frontage, glazed facade and orange canopy within the mapped building polygon.

references.filename: Eurotunnel Shuttle terminal building, with the Cité Europe shopping center in the background, Coquelles, 2024.jpg

originalReview.notes: The 2024 view from the passenger approach shows a broad orange-to-red roof canopy, curtain glazing, white circular columns, the recessed entrance and gray metal panel walls; the distant Cité Europe building and displayed advertisements are outside the scope.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact published Qualla original matches the only Commons file upload. DimiTalen is the photographer and original uploader, and used an explicit own-work CC0 dedication. The camera coordinates are recorded on the source page.
